name: Hydrating Face Serum
description: A lightweight serum that deeply hydrates and plumps the skin.
how_to_use: Apply 2-3 drops to clean face before moisturiser.

name: Brightening Eye Cream
description: Reduces dark circles and puffiness around the eye area.
ingredients: Aqua, Caffeine, Vitamin C, Peptides, Shea Butter
how_to_use: Gently pat around the eye area morning and night.

name: Purifying Clay Mask
description: Deep-cleansing mask that draws out impurities and tightens pores.
ingredients: Kaolin Clay, Bentonite, Tea Tree Oil, Aloe Vera
how_to_use: Apply evenly to face. Leave for 10 minutes then rinse.
